component.name: Todo Widget
component.summary: Daily to-do list for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: A daily to-do list for the COSMIC panel. Tasks can be grouped in folders, reordered by drag and drop, and the list follows the COSMIC theme.
The Flatpak version runs as a panel applet. The free-standing desktop widget needs the native install, because COSMIC does not let sandboxed apps draw on the desktop.
